value.rationale: A biologically motivated competition between dispersal and shared catastrophe risk creates a genuinely sharp change from a finite improving reserve-separation interval to no improving finite placement; the unique catastrophe-dependent critical ratio and tangency are complete natural classifications of a published metapopulation model, not a routine numerical table. The theorem distinguishes a true finite maximum from a visually similar asymptotic plateau and supplies an exact operational diagnostic within an idealized model. It does not claim field calibration or general ecosystem applicability.
